HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and extra batteries/memory cards
- Medications and first aid kit
- Reusable water bottle

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing (t-shirts, shorts, sundresses)
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip-flops
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel - optional as can be rented)
- Water shoes for rocky beaches

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Sturdy hiking shoes/boots
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight long pants (for hiking at Diamond Head)
- Day backpack
- Insect repellent

EVENING & SPECIAL OCCASIONS:
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Luau-appropriate attire (aloha shirt, floral dress)
- Light sweater for air-conditioned restaurants

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Quick-dry travel towel
- Small day bag/backpack
- Travel adapter if needed
- Books or e-reader for beach relaxation
- Snacks for day trips

REMEMBER:
- Pack light as you'll be moving around
- Most items can be purchased in Hawaii if forgotten
- Check weather forecast before finalizing your list
